definitions.gloss: cherry blossoms viewed at night, nighttime cherry blossom viewing
definitions.explanation: Cherry blossoms illuminated and enjoyed at night, typically lit up with lanterns or spotlights. A seasonal tradition in Japan during spring.

examples.japanese: {夜桜|よざくら}を{見|み}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go see the cherry blossoms at night.

examples.japanese: ライトアップされた{夜桜|よざくら}がとても{幻想的|げんそうてき}だった。
examples.english: The illuminated cherry blossoms at night were very enchanting.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{夜桜|よざくら}を{楽|たの}しみながら、{友人|ゆうじん}たちと{花見|はなみ}{酒|ざけ}を{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed the cherry blossoms at night in the park while drinking sake with friends.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Many parks and temples set up special lighting during cherry blossom season to allow visitors to enjoy {夜桜|よざくら}. The blossoms appear pale and ethereal under artificial light, creating a different atmosphere from daytime viewing. {夜桜|よざくら}{見物|けんぶつ} (nighttime cherry blossom viewing) is a popular spring activity.

FORMS:
{夜|よ} (night) + {桜|さくら} (cherry blossom). The さ becomes ざ through rendaku (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜桜|よざくら}{見物|けんぶつ}: nighttime cherry blossom viewing
- {夜桜|よざくら}のライトアップ: nighttime cherry blossom illumination
- {夜桜|よざくら}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy nighttime cherry blossoms
